question: Where should the laying down of those beings be ritually conducted in relation to the lord of gods?
premises: The lord of gods is the reference point.
The base of his feet is the specified location.
The laying down of them is to be conducted there.
inference: One should conduct their laying down at the base of the lord of gods' feet.
uncertainties: The identity of 'them' depends on prior context.
plain_english: One should also conduct their laying down at the base of the lord of gods' feet.
